author: Schnubbirunkel
tagline: Remote podcast studio – every guest on their own track
description:
Record remote podcasts in the browser. Every participant is recorded locally in full quality as a separate MP3 track and uploaded to your server while you talk – a shaky connection does not affect the recording.

Includes a multitrack editor (clips, ripple cuts, fades, envelopes, gate, EQ, compressor, limiter, loudness normalisation), a media pool for intros, outros and jingles, and an export that renders the finished episode on your server.

On first start you set a password, the language and the folders for recordings, exports and the media pool. For guests outside your network you need an HTTPS address (e.g. Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale Funnel) – see the README.

tips.before_install: After installation, open the app: the setup screen asks for a password, the language and the storage folders. Guests from outside your network need an HTTPS address for camera and microphone.

title: Remote Booth
release_note: Screen sharing at 30 fps (15 fps in power-saving mode) with higher bitrate, H.264 hardware encoding where available, and an info badge showing resolution, fps, codec and hardware/software encoding.
